title: Arquiteto De Software
description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown. Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

description: About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut. We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you’ll be doing Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times Participating in projects with management as required Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes What you'll need Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications Fluency in English and Portuguese We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day. Exploring the role RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership description:

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\ "The Rails Way\"), garantindoque a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile. Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura. Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog. 2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima. Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Tech Engenharia Devops Sênior
description:
O especialista DevOps irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, e cresce a cada dia, ampliando continuamente seu potencial de impacto e inovação. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER: Orientar no processo de administração de dados e ambientes, através da execução de rotinas e ferramentas envolvidas na área, estipulando os prazos e prioridades da equipe. Realizar atividade de triagem dos tickets abertos pelos clientes internos através da classificação ou categorização dos mesmos quando necessário, por tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento. Promover ações de melhoria através da participação ativa das cerimônias do Ágil (Daily, reabastecimento, reviews e retrospectivas) Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/meta da área através da execução de suas atividades propostas Identificar problemas de ambientes DevOps, integração contínua, e banco de dados implementando e inovando em soluções. Estimular a equipe em processos de melhoria, usando seu conhecimento e experiência para identificar problemas e desenvolver soluções. Garantir a sustentabilidade dos ambientes através da orientação dos demais integrantes do time no uso de boas práticas de DevOps. Ser uma referência interna e externa em práticas DevOps, garantindo a sustentabilidade dos ambientes por meio da disseminação de conhecimento e participação de fóruns. Realizar pesquisa e avaliação de novas tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de mercado, com o objetivo de identificar e propor soluções que aprimorem a eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade dos ambientes e processos de desenvolvimento, integração e operação. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ: Metodologia Ágil – nível domínio;
Kubernetes – nível avançado;
Cloud Pública (AWS, Azure, GCP) – nível intermediário;
Azure DevOps –nível intermediário;
Linux, containers e ferramentas de automação – nível avançado;
CI/CD – nível avançado;
Arquitetura Cloud Native – nível intermediário. Certificação: CKA Certified Kubernetes Administrator – desejável;
AWS Cloud Practitioner– desejável;
AWS Sysops Administrator – desejável;

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day. Exploring the role RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond. This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations. How your day will look like/Job responsibility Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.G. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs) Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills: Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude: Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo. Must-haves 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end) Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.Js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data Plusses Experience with C++ development Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes Day-to-Day You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The role is front-end heavy (~70%), involving refactoring and enhancing React, Handlebars, and ASP.NET components to meet accessibility standards. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

title: Senior Buyer
description:
Senior Buyer (Indirect Procurement) A global organization is hiring a Senior Buyer to join its Indirect Category team. This role supports a wide range of indirect spend categories (e.G., travel, corporate services, facilities, IT services, training, uniforms/workwear, and other business services), partnering closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver an efficient end-to-end purchasing experience. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;

title: Project Manager - Digital Technology
description: Project Manager - Digital Technology Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Digital Technology (DT) Project Manager to join our team. The DT Project Manager will be responsible for planning, leading, organizing, and motivating project teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in delivering projects that provide exceptional business value to users. This role requires a high degree of collaboration with leaders across the organization. Key Responsibilities:Project Planning and Management: Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment. Scope, Schedule, and Resource Management: Manage all aspects of projects including scope, schedule, resources, quality, costs, change, and risk to ensure the overall program is aligned to and directly supports the achievement of strategic objectives. Financial Management: Oversee project budgets, track expenditures, and ensure financial objectives are met. Provide regular financial reports and forecasts to stakeholders. Project Monitoring & Control: Prepare estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project. Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources. Transparency and Reporting: Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks & issues, communicating across leadership. Agile Practices: Organize and facilitate release planning, daily stand-up meetings, and reviews. Track and communicate scrum metrics including team velocity and sprint/release progress. Quality Management: Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution. Risk Management: Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans Experience and Skills: Experience in Agile & Waterfall methodologies. Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and interpersonal skills. Experience in successfully leading projects and programs to from initiation to closure. Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. Experience partnering with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams. Flexible with proven ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Flexible work hours when needed to align with counterparts at other Otis locations. Support diverse and inclusive work environment. Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science, IT, MIS or equivalent work experience. Minimum of 5 years of hands-on project management experience, including initiating, tracking and planning projects. Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, PPM and Agile tools. PMP Certification required. Agile certifications are highly desirable

title: Language Specialist
description: Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training (Freelancer)Location: Brazil (Remote – Candidates must be based in Brazil)About the Role:As a Language Specialist, you will play a vital role in training and enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). This involves evaluating prompts, rating AI-generated outputs, and creating high-quality content to improve the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of AI systems used by global technology leaders.Key Responsibilities:Evaluate AI-generated prompts and responses for linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance.Provide structured ratings and feedback on AI outputs, highlighting errors, biases, or inconsistencies.Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains.Collaborate with linguists, annotators, and AI researchers to refine model performance.Ensure cultural and linguistic nuances are accurately represented.Follow established guidelines while also suggesting improvements for evaluation frameworks. Qualifications:Strong written and spoken command of the target language, with excellent grammar and stylistic skills.Prior experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred.Analytical mindset with keen attention to detail.Interest in AI, NLP, or LLMs will be an advantage.

title: Arquiteto De Software
description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown. Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Job Title: Lead Generation Specialist Location : Home-based Country: Brazil About the role: In this role, you will create and execute high-impact demand generation programs across the Brazilian market. Sales partnership: Build target account lists and joint GTM plans with Sales Directors;
enable teams with localized ABM playbooks and content. Tech + intent: Operationalize ABM/intent platforms (e.G., Bombora, Demandbase/6sense/RollWorks) and convert signals into orchestrated journeys. Attribution discipline: Drive clean segmentation, routing, UTM/tagging, and reporting with digital operations. How you’ll execute: Localization that performs: Tailor narratives to local regulations, industries, and buyer behavior;
ensure cultural nuancein copy and creative. Cross-functional sync: Coordinate with field marketing, content, and ops to deliver on time and on brand via Workfront. How you’ll measure success: Demand quality: MQLs, SAL/SQL conversion, pipeline contribution, opportunities created. Channel economics: CPL/CAC, influenced revenue, multi-touch attribution. Operational health: Launch timeliness, rework reduction, attribution accuracy (UTM coverage). What you bring: ABM and demand expertise across segmentation, lead scoring, and personalized content delivery. Martech fluency: Salesforce, Pardot (or Marketo), Workfront;
hands-on with ABM/intent tools (Demandbase, 6sense, RollWorks, Bombora, Apollo). Experience in building dashboards, reading patterns, and prioritizing optimizations. Strong collaborator across countries, time zones, and stakeholders;
crisp communicator. Anorganized and detail-oriented approach Confidence in managing multiple campaigns at one time. A growth mindset with proactive problem-solving skills. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field. Experience in B2B demand gen/digital/ABM with measurable campaign success (professional services, SaaS, or regulated industries preferred). Experience in matrixed/global organizations and familiarity with B2B buyer journeys. Proficiency with Salesforce, Pardot, Workfront, and ABM platforms. Language & travel: Languages: Strong command of English and Portuguese both verbal and written. Travel may be required to attend events. Additional information: Please submit your resume in English. title: Innovation & Strategy Engineer
description: Sensor Tower is seeking an Innovation & Strategy Engineer to join our I&S team as it continues to grow and deliver cutting-edge market intelligence solutions to our most valued clients. Reporting directly to the Director of Innovation and Strategy, this role offers a unique opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in data analytics and consulting. You will collaborate directly with customers and engineers to develop and implement innovative market data solutions, contributing to Sensor Tower's leadership in the industry. Please note: This is an individual contributor role with no management responsibilities. Employment: Full-time under a B2B contract. What the Innovation & Strategy will do: Entrepreneurial Innovation & Data Utilization: Leverage your hands-on experience with data to explore and define innovative solutions, developing new use-cases for data assets that scale to create strategic opportunities Data-Driven Storytelling: Employ strong analytical and storytelling skills to transform complex data into compelling narratives that communicate insights and persuade stakeholders both internally and externally. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, engineering, and customers to develop and implement comprehensive solutions, ensuring strategic alignment and integration Client Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including Fortune 500 companies, ensuring their success through strategic insights and tailored solutions. Sales & Strategic Support: Partner with the Sales Team to support business development efforts, articulating the strategic impact of our solutions and aiding in the proposal process. Experience and skills that the candidate can bring: Data Proficiency: Proven ability to manage and analyze large datasets independently, developing innovative solutions and actionable insights. Expertise in data analysis and visualization tools (SQL, Python, Excel, Tableau, Power BI). Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated track record of identifying, scaling, and creating new data use-cases that drive significant business value. An entrepreneurial approach to developing strategic opportunities. Communication and Collaboration: Ability to transform complex data into compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders. Experience in cross-functional collaboration with sales, engineering, and client teams to implement integrated solutions. Client Relations: Proven experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships with high-profile clients, including Fortune 500 companies, focusing on client success and satisfaction. Fraud warning: It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as LinkedIn, Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob. At no point will Sensor Tower ever ask for money, credit card, or bank account information to complete a job application. Communications received from Sensor Tower are only sent by e-mail addresses ending in sensortower.Com. All Sensor Tower interviews will be conducted via phone or Zoom. At no time will a conversation be moved to an alternative email outside of sensortower.Com or text.

title: Gerente De Segurança Da Informação
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG. Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais. Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro. Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas! Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira! Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas. Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente! Principais atividades: Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização. Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS). Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional. Buscamos alguém que apresente: Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR) Conhecimento específicos: Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48 Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
- Busquem consciênciasocial de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
- Identifiquem eantecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
- Planejem e executemo trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
- Gerem e implementemnovas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado. Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada! Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
- Acesso à plataformaOrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
- Licença maternidadee paternidade estendidas;
- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida. Proteção e estabilidade: - Previdência privada;
- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida. Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Vale-Transporte;
- Auxílio-Creche;
- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços. Desenvolvimento e educação: - Plataforma de ensino;

title: Analista De Testes Sênior
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that.
--- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.
--- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.
--- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.
--- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.
--- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.
--- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation** - Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field** - Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent) - **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a\ "stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.
--- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.** - **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.
--- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.
--- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **\ "Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\ "** Bespecific. We want theactual story.

description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.
