Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge. About the Opportunity Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption. The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience. Responsibilities Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients. Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations. Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability. Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live. Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments. Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health. Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability. Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch. Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations. Qualifications At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles. Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams. Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms. Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously. Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle. Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Job Title: Lead Generation Specialist Location : Home-based Country: Brazil About the role: In this role, you will create and execute high-impact demand generation programs across the Brazilian market. You will harness data and intent to engage buying groups across key areas such as Training, System Certification, ISA, and Digital Trust, adapting global strategies for local realities. You'll also partner closely with Sales Directors and the Global Digital Hub to convert interest into opportunities. If you’re a bilingual/tri-lingual, hands-on strategist who thrives in a matrixed environment, come and build the engine that feeds our pipeline across Latin America. What you will own: Regional demand strategy: Define the LATAM demand plan tied to MQL, SQL, and opportunity targets by country, sector, and persona. Multi-channel execution: Launch integrated programs across email, LinkedIn/paid social, paid search, webinars/events, and content syndication, localized for Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Sales partnership: Build target account lists and joint GTM plans with Sales Directors;
enable teams with localized ABM playbooks and content. Tech + intent: Operationalize ABM/intent platforms (e.G., Bombora, Demandbase/6sense/RollWorks) and convert signals into orchestrated journeys. Attribution discipline: Drive clean segmentation, routing, UTM/tagging, and reporting with digital operations. How you’ll execute: Localization that performs: Tailor narratives to local regulations, industries, and buyer behavior;
ensure cultural nuancein copy and creative. Cross-functional sync: Coordinate with field marketing, content, and ops to deliver on time and on brand via Workfront. How you’ll measure success: Demand quality: MQLs, SAL/SQL conversion, pipeline contribution, opportunities created. Channel economics: CPL/CAC, influenced revenue, multi-touch attribution. Operational health: Launch timeliness, rework reduction, attribution accuracy (UTM coverage). What you bring: ABM and demand expertise across segmentation, lead scoring, and personalized content delivery. Martech fluency: Salesforce, Pardot (or Marketo), Workfront;
hands-on with ABM/intent tools (Demandbase, 6sense, RollWorks, Bombora, Apollo). Experience in building dashboards, reading patterns, and prioritizing optimizations. Strong collaborator across countries, time zones, and stakeholders;
crisp communicator. Anorganized and detail-oriented approach Confidence in managing multiple campaigns at one time. A growth mindset with proactive problem-solving skills. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field. Experience in B2B demand gen/digital/ABM with measurable campaign success (professional services, SaaS, or regulated industries preferred). Experience in matrixed/global organizations and familiarity with B2B buyer journeys. Proficiency with Salesforce, Pardot, Workfront, and ABM platforms. Language & travel: Languages: Strong command of English and Portuguese both verbal and written. Travel may be required to attend events. Additional information: Please submit your resume in English. title: Analista De Testes Sênior
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that. --- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations. --- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence. --- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet. --- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company. --- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream. --- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a "stable" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you. --- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.**- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us. --- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply. --- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage."** Be specific. We want the actual story.

title: Analista De Testes Sênior
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that. --- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations. --- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence. --- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet. --- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company. --- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream. --- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a "stable" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you. --- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.**- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us. --- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply. --- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage."** Be specific. We want the actual story.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description: Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship. We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets. Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region. What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling Sourcing & Due Diligence Industry and Company Research And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals. Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing. This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals. Who We're Looking For: This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment. How to Apply: Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase. This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

description: Senior Product Manager – Digital Acquisition (Nike Brasil | Grupo SBF) Seu Desafio Não buscamos um\ "piloto de backlog\" ,mas umPM com olhar empreendedor e profundidade no negócio. Você será o responsável por liderar a estratégia de Digital Acquisition do site e app da Nike no Brasil, legal, né? Sua missão é clara: atrair novos usuários, dominar a busca orgânica e transformar a experiência de descoberta de produtos em uma máquina de crescimento sustentável. Aqui, Produto = Negócio. Você terá autonomia para executar o que acredita, desde que suas convicções sejam embasadas por dados, pensamento crítico e uma visão profunda do mercado de varejo. O que você vai fazer Atrair pessoas e torná-las usuárias recorrentes através de: Domínio de SEO & Discovery: Liderar SEO técnico (indexabilidade, performance, arquitetura de URLs) e evoluir a encontrabilidade (Busca, Filtros, Grids e Menus). Playbook de Growth: Priorizar iniciativas de alto impacto como\ "Avise-me\", Web/App Pushes eGrowth Loops. Influência e Educação: Atuar como um agente que eleva a maturidade digital da organização, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções tecnológicas escaláveis. O Perfil que buscamos 1. Visão de Negócio & Estratégia: Você mergulha no segmento, entende de marketing, economia e negociação. Consegue encontrar brechas no mercado e transformá-las em vantagem competitiva. 2. Capacidade Analítica\ "Data-Informed\": Saber dizer\ "não\" é sua maior ferramentade priorização. Você usa dados (quant e quali) para convencer, inferir o tamanho de oportunidades e validar hipóteses. 3. Execução e Senso de Urgência: O varejo não espera. Precisamos de maestria na execução, foco e dedicação. Aqui, trabalhamos com velocidade, inteligência e sem acomodação. 4. Mentalidade AI Native: Você utiliza IA como ferramenta fundamental no dia a dia — seja para acelerar análises, escrever queries no BigQuery ou estruturar narrativas. 5. Articulação Cross-functional: Constrói relacionamentos sólidos com Engenharia, Design e Mídia, movimentando pessoas em prol de uma visão comum. Requisitos Sólida experiência como PM Sênior, preferencialmente em Growth ou Aquisição Digital. Conhecimento técnico e estratégico em SEO, navegação e experiência de busca. Familiaridade com o stack de dados: GA4, Search Console e SQL (BigQuery). Habilidade de validação ágil: Saber gerar valor desde o\ "dia zero\", validando ideiasde forma rápida (muitas vezes sem código). KPIs: O que define o seu sucesso? Receita incremental atribuída à aquisição. Qualidade de visualização de Grid e PDP. Volume e conversão de sessões orgânicas. Retenção de tráfego (Return Visitors). Por que essa vaga? Se você tem senso de ownership, não se contenta com o básico e quer liderar o digital da maior marca esportiva do mundo dentro de um ambiente de varejo competitivo e dinâmico, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Product Specialist
description: About the Role: CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support, Cyber Threat Takedown Operations, and Security Event Analysis. You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence. This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1 Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone. Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools. Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision. Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues. Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries. Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection. 2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms. Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms. Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders. Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse. Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure. 3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring) As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal. Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats. Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols. Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories. Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling. Desired Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields. Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations. Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats. Strong communication skills (written & verbal). Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers. Experience with support ticketing tools (e.G., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk). Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.G., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools). Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required). Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus. Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory. Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish Working Conditions: Location: Brazil Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure). Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST). Why Join Us? Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and digital risk protection. Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response. Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment. Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description: About SEW SEW.Ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas, Solar and eMobility industry. Quick Highlights 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector. Role Summary The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.Ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years. The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets. This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions. Key Responsibilities Client Engagement & Solution Consulting Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements. Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards. Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation. Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases. Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases. Product & Architecture Alignment Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights. Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy. Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings. Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness. Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success. Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance. Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value. Process Optimization & Innovation Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization. Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions. Required Qualifications Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role. Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities. Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector. Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations. Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities. Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations). Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams. Willingness to travel approximately 30%. Preferred Technical Background Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures. Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#. Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description: Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level? At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video. We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment. Your Goals Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences). Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels. Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages). Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts. Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners. Qualifications 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count). Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot). Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities. Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills. Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment. Benefits Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team. Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded. Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video. Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path. 100% Remote position working with a global team. Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit. About Us Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably. Our Values: - Treat others the way we want to be treated.
- Pay close attention to detail.
- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.
- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.
- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision. Who We Are Looking For: We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus. The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients. The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands. Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads. Responsibilities Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses) Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients Autonomous worker with an analytical mind Portfolio of work, results, or case studies You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.Com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.Com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not. You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that. Compensation: $2000 - $8000 USD per month Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description: We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes. About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice. If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading. What You’ll Own Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells. Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage. Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs. Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies. Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual What We’re Looking For 5+ years of SaaS marketing experience (SMB-focused)3+ years specializing in product marketing at a fast-moving SaaS company Proven success owning end-to-end product marketing campaigns — from idea to impact Deep experience with in-app messaging apps, such as, AppCues Strong analytical mindset — you track KPIs, act on insights, and prioritize what moves the numbers Sharp communicator, listener, and writer with a strategic mind and bias for execution Self-directed operator who doesn’t need hand-holding to deliver results Detail-oriented, process-driven, and KPI-aware Self-starter mindset — you Google before you ask, and always show up with solutions Process-oriented team player who can document, scale, and systemize efforts Team player, highly coachable, and positive attitude — always Able to work U.S. time zones, full-time ✨ Bonus Points Experience in marketing to real estate professionals Background in direct-response copywriting ⚡️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays High autonomy, fast execution, and a CMO who actually values great marketing Full ownership over your work — real impact, not just tickets Professional development benefit Health & wellness benefit Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role Please Don’t Apply If: You don’t meet the minimum product marketing experience You’ve never run a product marketing campaign from start to finish No experience working for a SaaS company You need micromanagement or daily check-ins to be productive You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You’re not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams Ready to grow with us? We’re looking for a proven product marketer ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that’s you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Product Specialist
description: About the Role: CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support, Cyber Threat Takedown Operations, and Security Event Analysis. You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence. This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1 Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone. Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools. Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision. Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues. Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries. Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection. 2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms. Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms. Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders. Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse. Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure. 3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring) As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal. Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats. Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols. Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories. Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling. Desired Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields. Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations. Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats. Strong communication skills (written & verbal). Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers. Experience with support ticketing tools (e.G., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk). Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.G., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools). Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required). Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus. Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory. Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish Working Conditions: Location: Brazil Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure). Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST). Why Join Us? Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and digital risk protection. Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response. Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment. title: Sap S/4hana Finance Consultant
description: Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support. The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics. The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion. Duties and Responsibilities: The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction. Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations Minimum Qualifications/Experience: 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred). Required Certifications: Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus. changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management Requirements 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices Nice to Have Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue Compensation and Benefits Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. title: Database Administrator
description: As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication. Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT. Responsibilities: Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage. Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments. Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database. Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test. Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting. Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency. Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing. Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations. Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database. Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures. Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies. Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects. Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers. Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience. A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle. 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments. Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture. Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool. Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment. Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing. Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s) Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable. Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios. A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. title: Tech Lead Ruby On Rails
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial. O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida. Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento. Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada. Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\ "The Rails Way\"), garantindoque a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile. Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura. Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog. 2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima. Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. title: Database Administrator
description: As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication. Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT. Responsibilities: Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage. Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments. Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database. Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test. Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting. Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency. Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing. Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations. Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database. Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures. Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies. Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects. Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers. Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience. A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle. 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments. Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture. Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool. Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment. Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing. Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s) Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable. Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios. A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description: Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level? At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video. We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment. Your Goals Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences). Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels. Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages). Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts. Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners. Qualifications 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count). Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills. Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment. Benefits Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team. Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded. Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video. Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path. 100% Remote position working with a global team. Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit. About Us Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
